allowed_errors.meaning: The requested Labstep-shaped entity id is absent from sandbox state.
The sandbox payload does not match the selected Labstep public example shape.
The agent attempted a credentialed or production Labstep API call instead of the dry-run source pack.

dry_run_semantics: Experiment workflow, comment, protocol collection, and resource item records are sandbox records shaped from official Labstep public JSON examples.
Create and update tools mutate only sandbox state and return the exact public Labstep example response shape selected for that operation family.
Read tools return sandbox records keyed by Labstep-style ids, guids, thread ids, and permission entity info without calling a live Labstep workspace.

live_boundary.boundary_statement: This source pack forbids production Labstep workspace mutations, credentialed live Labstep API calls, and writes against any real Labstep tenant.

role: ELN experiment workflow, comment, protocol, and inventory operations grounded in official Labstep OpenAPI examples.

tools.dry_run_behavior: Reads sandbox experiment workflow records using the exact Labstep public list response example shape.
tools.operation: GET /api/generic/experiment-workflow - Retrieve a list of ExperimentWorkflow.

tools.dry_run_behavior: Reads one sandbox experiment workflow record using the exact public example referenced by Labstep's get_single operation.
Creates a sandbox experiment workflow record and returns the exact Labstep public created ExperimentWorkflow example shape.
tools.operation: POST /api/generic/experiment-workflow - Create one or multiple ExperimentWorkflow.

tools.dry_run_behavior: Updates a sandbox experiment workflow record and returns the exact Labstep public updated ExperimentWorkflow example shape.
tools.operation: PUT /api/generic/experiment-workflow - Updates one of multiple ExperimentWorkflow.

tools.dry_run_behavior: Creates a sandbox comment in a Labstep-style thread and returns the exact Labstep public created comment example shape.
tools.operation: POST /api/generic/comment - Creates one or multiple Comment.

tools.dry_run_behavior: Creates a sandbox protocol collection and returns the exact Labstep public created ProtocolCollection example shape.
tools.operation: POST /api/generic/protocol-collection - Creates one or multiple ProtocolCollection.

tools.dry_run_behavior: Reads one sandbox inventory item using the exact Labstep public ResourceItem example shape.
Creates a sandbox inventory item and returns the exact Labstep public created ResourceItem example shape.
